title: Processes
description: What this box keeps running. A process that exits is started again, waiting a little longer each time. Changes here reach the box at the next deploy.
saved: Saved. The next deploy applies it.
notRunning: Switched off, so it isn't running.
unreachable: This box isn't running, so its processes can't be read. Deploy or start it first.
emptyBody: Add a process, or enable a web server on the Modules tab.
deleteBody: It stops at the next deploy. Its files stay in the workspace.

dialog.description: Run with /bin/sh in the workspace. It can use anything the modules install.

fields.name: Name
fields.commandHint: Run by /bin/sh, so it can be a whole pipeline.
fields.directoryHint: Inside the workspace. Use . for the workspace itself.
fields.enabledHint: Switch off to keep it here without running it.

errors.name: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.
errors.directory: Use a folder inside the workspace.
